FN-RBBZLMM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 190
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Steve Livingston
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/04/2025
Senate Bill 190 as introduced would require health benefit plans to offer annual prostrate cancer
early detection screening to certain high risk males without cost-sharing requirements, which
would increase the costs of: (1) the State Employees' Health Insurance Plan (SEHIP) by an
estimated $200,000 annually; and (2) the Public Education Employees Health Insurance Plan
(PEEHIP) by an estimated $160,000 annually.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 190
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Senator Steve Livingston
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/21/2025
Senate Bill 190 as passed the Senate would require certain health benefit plans to offer annual
prostate cancer early detection screening to certain high risk males without cost-sharing
requirements, which would increase the costs of: (1) the State Employees' Health Insurance Plan
(SEHIP) by an estimated $247,000 annually; and (2) the Public Education Employees Health
Insurance Plan (PEEHIP) by an estimated $160,000 annually.
